memos.headline: Long follow-up of a Phase 2 cohort at ESMO; the market is selling it (IOVA -2.8% since)
reasoning: Source: Benzinga 14:18 UTC: 'Iovance's Phase 2 Lifileucel Plus Pembrolizumab Delivers 62.5% ORR And 29.2% Complete Response Rate In Frontline Advanced Melanoma, With Median OS Not Yet Reached At 50.9 Months'. Company release not in our feeds; no body text.

What changed: more follow-up on a single-arm Phase 2 cohort in a setting where Iovance's registrational Phase 3 is the trial that matters. Durable responses at 51 months are good news for the drug's profile, but they extend an existing data set.
Price: IOVA 13.955 to 13.56 since the item (-2.8%), and -4.2% on the day: sold on the news.
objections: Incremental update of a Phase 2 cohort; the stock is falling on it.

memos.headline: IOVA: no trade. ESMO update of a Phase 2 cohort; stock -2.8% on it
reasoning: 62.5% response rate, 29.2% complete responses, median survival not reached at 50.9 months, in frontline melanoma with pembrolizumab.
Pattern this week: conference updates of known trials (casdatifan, IDE849, lutikizumab, lifileucel) rarely move stocks up; several fell.
objections: Incremental update of a Phase 2 cohort; the stock is falling on it.

memos.headline: 'Confirms': full Phase 3 data for a combination whose topline was already reported; ONC flat
reasoning: Source: Benzinga 14:18 UTC: 'BeOne Medicines Announces Its Data From Phase 3 HERIZON-GEA-01 Study Confirms Benefits Of TEVIMBRA + ZIIHERA ... HER2-Positive Locally Advanced Or Metastatic Gastroesophageal Adenocarcinoma'. No body text.

'Confirms benefits' means the topline result was already public; this is the detailed presentation (ESMO week). Ziihera is partnered in, and Tevimbra is one of BeOne's marketed drugs: for a $553B company, one combination label is small.
Price: ONC -0.1% since the item, on 704 IEX shares.
objections: Detailed data for an already-reported Phase 3; immaterial at BeOne's size.
